summary: Add logging to SDKs when workflow task completion takes a long time due to external storage operations. The worker should log metrics about payload downloads/uploads when durations exceed 5 seconds (info level) or 10 seconds (warning level).
userImpact: Users need better visibility into workflow task duration and external storage operation performance to prevent and diagnose timeout issues.
rootCause: External storage operations (download/upload) add latency to workflow task completion, causing them to approach or exceed timeouts, with no visibility into the actual duration.
proposedFix: Log external storage metrics including total wall clock time, payload count, and payload size for both downloads and uploads at info level when >5s and warning level when >10s, using TMPRL1104 rule.
keyQuote: With the introduction of external storage, downloading and uploading payload from/to external storage contributes to the workflow task duration.
